newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end flat on central bank issue.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end flat on central bank issue.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed stable on Tuesday, halting a recent downtrend after the central bank issued T$10 billion in negotiable certificates of deposit to mop up excess liquidity, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.048 percent against Monday's 5.053 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.05-5.10 percent against 5.10-5.15 percent.
Dealers nonetheless cautioned that the central bank issue had had very little effect on the market's long-term liquidity level and that the rates should fall again soon.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield fell sharply to 6.1300 against 6.2800-6.2750 after the government auctioned T$50 billion worth of the bond.
